text: Michael Sandel has taught Justice at Harvard since 1980. The course is famous for packing Sanders Theatre.
Sandel's Justice lectures were filmed for WGBH and still circulate as the public version of the course.
Shelly Kagan's Death course at Yale argues that the badness of death is mostly what it takes from you, not a felt experience.
Bryan Magee's BBC interviews put working philosophers on television without a studio audience to laugh them off the point.
A lecture cut for television is still a lecture. The slate is just the hallway between rooms.
